name: render_list_services
description: List services in a Render workspace. Returns an array of wrapped items; each service has `id` (e.g. 'srv-...', the serviceId every custom-domain tool needs), `name`, `type` (web_service, static_site, ...), and `serviceDetails` — whose `url` is the service's own onrender.com hostname (needed to build the CNAME target for subdomain custom domains). Optional `ownerId` to scope to one workspace (from render_list_owners; required only if the key has multiple workspaces), `name` to filter by service name, `limit` (1-100, default 20), and `cursor` for the next page (cursor pagination).

ownerId.description: Workspace id to scope to (from render_list_owners). Omit if the key has a single workspace.

name.description: Filter to services whose name matches. Omit to list all.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous page's response. Omit for the first page.
